review.notes: Full review. All 15 sampled targets and every other statement recomputed (adversarial table); van Handel's notes read at 7 locators, all correct; Boucheron-Lugosi-Massart, Ledoux, Ledoux-Talagrand, Massart and Bercu-Delyon-Rio could not be read legally (listed as not verifiable). Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry the only warning; one-tactic probe closes none of the 45 theorems; dependency check 0 problems; no change outside the folder. Findings: two misstated applications of the comparison lemma in the routes of 4.4 and 6.3 (P2); Levy's inequality of 7.2 duplicates, for real summands, a target of the open roadmap SeriesOfIndependentRandomVariables 2.2 (P2). One automatic form check set aside as a false positive.
